state_of_the_art.statement: The minimum total is 220. Every target up to 128 needs at most three pairwise non-dividing 5-smooth summands, and an exhaustive search for each target (scripts/check_state_of_the_art.py) gives per-target minima that sum to 220. The d-completeness of such sequences was conjectured by Erdős and Lewin (Erdős Problem #123, now proved).
